name: Long exhale

cues.text: Breathe in gently, then let the out-breath be longer and slower.
There are no holds. Keep the breath soft.
If you feel dizzy, stop and breathe normally.

stop_prompts: Stop if you feel dizzy or lightheaded.
Stop if you feel tingling or numbness in your hands or face.
Stop if your chest feels tight.
Stop if your vision changes or blurs.
You can stop at any time.

copy.intent: Breathe in gently and let a longer out-breath settle you.
copy.end: Let your breath return to its own rhythm. Notice how you feel now.
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: Research gives 4 s in and 6 to 8 s out; 6 s chosen so the rate is exactly 6 breaths per minute (8 s gives 5). The source trial match is not confirmed (snippet). Verify before release.
